profile.description: Semiconductor Manufacturing International Corporation, an investment holding company, engages in the manufacture, testing, and sale of integrated circuits wafer and various compound semiconductors in the United States, China, and Eurasia. The company is also involved in the manufacturing, sale, and trading of semiconductor products; and research and development activities. In addition, it offers semiconductor foundry and technology services; supporting services comprising design and IP support, photomask manufacturing, etc.; development, design, and technical services related to integrated circuits; marketing related services; and private education services. Further, the company tests and sells self-produced products, and other services. Semiconductor Manufacturing International Corporation was incorporated in 2000 and is headquartered in Shanghai, China.

summary: SMIC Q2 2026 revenue hit $3.01B (+20% QoQ), beating estimates by 5.6%; EPS of $0.06 exceeded forecast by 61.3% on AI chip demand.
Gross margin improved to 25.3% from 20.1% prior quarter; EBITDA margin reached record 70.2% with operating cash flow of $2.52B.
Q3 guidance projects 2-4% sequential revenue growth to $3.07-3.13B; gross margin expected to rise further to 26-28% range.
AI peripheral chips, computing, industrial and automotive segments drove growth; utilization at 93.7% expected to reach 95% next quarter.
Depreciation forecast to rise 30% YoY to $4.9-5.0B in 2026, potentially peaking in 2027; company adding 8,000 wafers monthly capacity.
